patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: Bottle opener. Yes, with my teeth. Yes, I know. It doesn't even hurt, it's just — a bit of it is gone and I panicked.
presentation.triageNote: 22-year-old male with a small enamel chip to an upper incisor with no pain or bleeding; the tooth is stable and there is no other facial injury.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because this small enamel-only tooth chip has no pain, pulp exposure, mobility, bleeding, or associated injury and requires no emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has a minor stable dental enamel fracture.
clinical.acuityReason: This small enamel-only tooth chip has no pain, pulp exposure, mobility, bleeding, or associated injury and requires no emergency resource.
teachingPoints: Enamel only, no pulp exposure, no mobility, no other injury. Pink or bleeding at the fracture site would mean pulp involvement and a same-day dentist.
Triage should be based on the current presentation and expected care, with reassessment if new warning signs appear.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Dental follow-up and protection of any sharp edge would allow discharge.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.

signs: one finger lifting the upper lip
a small chip in a front tooth
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character. Match the painterly STYLE of the attached reference image - its brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting and palette - but do NOT copy its cropping, camera distance or composition. FRAMING (follow exactly): a full-body WIDE SHOT, square 1:1, 3/4 front view, subject centred. The ENTIRE figure must be inside the frame from the top of the head to the soles of both feet, and the ENTIRE chair must be inside the frame including all four chair legs meeting the floor. Leave clear empty margin on all four sides - roughly 10% of the image width as space above the head and below the feet. This is NOT a close-up, NOT a bust, NOT a head-and-shoulders portrait, NOT a cropped view: the camera is pulled well back so the whole person and the whole chair sit comfortably inside the picture with room around them. Draw the COMPLETE body - head, neck, torso, both arms, both hands, lap, both legs, both feet with shoes. Nothing cropped by the edges, no missing or truncated limbs, no body part fading out or left unfinished. Subject: a hispanic 22-year-old man in a casual shirt, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting forward, lifting his upper lip with one finger to show a front tooth. Expression: sheepish and faintly ridiculous. Clearly visible: one finger lifting the upper lip; a small chip in a front tooth. Overall: entirely well. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no border.
